sources.snippet: Welcome to the Tamil Handwriting Recognition Detection Model repository! This project aims to detect handwritten letters of the Tamil language using deep learning neural networks powered by TensorFlow and AI. The model utilizes the Inception V3 architecture (inception_v3) for accurate and efficient recognition.

sources.title: Methodical Tamil Character Recognition Using Fabricated CNN Model
sources.snippet: Methodical Tamil Character Recognition Using Fabricated CNN Model Abstract: Recognizing text is one of the most challenging problems in computer vision. To put it simply, handwritten character recognition is the process of recognising text in photographs, papers, and other media and converting it into a form that a computer can read.
